instruction: Set up a TLS certificate in 389 DS
output: dsconf localhost security certificate add --name serverCert --file /etc/dirsrv/slapd-localhost/server.crt --primary-cert

instruction: Set 389 DS TLS to require client certificates
Check 389 DS replication status for all agreements
Set 389 DS replication bind credentials
output: dsconf localhost repl-agmt set 'cn=myAgmt,cn=replica,cn=dc=example\2Cdc=com,cn=mapping tree,cn=config' --bind-passwd newpass

instruction: Delete a 389 DS replication agreement
output: dsconf localhost repl-agmt delete --suffix dc=example,dc=com --agmt-name myAgmt

instruction: Set up 389 DS winsync (AD sync) agreement
output: dsconf localhost winsync add --suffix dc=example,dc=com --ad-host ad.example.com --ad-port 389 --ad-bind-dn cn=sync,cn=users,dc=ad,dc=example,dc=com --ad-bind-passwd secret --sync-direction multi

instruction: Show 389 DS winsync status
Create a 389 DS certificate database
Set 389 DS password storage scheme
Set 389 DS minimum password length
Check 389 DS disk space monitoring
List all 389 DS logged errors currently
Enable 389 DS access log buffering
Set 389 DS maximum log size
output: dsconf localhost config replace nsslapd-errorlog-maxlogs-per-dir=10 nsslapd-errorlog-maxlogsize=100

instruction: Verify an LDIF file syntax before importing
Add a new LDAP index from config file
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcDbIndex
olcDbIndex: member eq,sub'

instruction: Remove an LDAP index
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
delete: olcDbIndex
olcDbIndex: uidNumber eq'

instruction: Set LDAP index with approximate matching
output:
ldapmodify -Y EXTERNAL -H ldapi:/// <<< 'dn: olcDatabase={1}mdb,cn=config
changetype: modify
add: olcDbIndex
olcDbIndex: cn pres,eq,approx,sub'

instruction: Create a sub-DN in LDAP for a department
output:
ldapadd -x -D cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com -W <<< 'dn: ou=engineering,dc=example,dc=com
objectClass: organizationalUnit
ou: engineering'

instruction: Rename an LDAP entry from old OU to new OU
Perform an LDAP extended operation for password modify
Compare a DN's attribute in LDAP to verify a value
Search LDAP with attribute subentry
Search LDAP for operational attributes (creatorsName, createTimestamp)
Search LDAP with all user and operational attributes
